_comment: P/Q-only ChamberSphere calibration. y/dy hold ONLY the four port variables (pressure/flow) and their time derivatives. The calibrator reconstructs the chamber's internal state from net flow and fits the active-stress equation analytically (no finite differences; wall inertia neglected). dy here was obtained by differentiating a forward run (test data only). See test_chamber_sphere_pq_calibration.
